en: Plants do not eat soil, but instead make their own food using sunlight, water, and carbon dioxide during photosynthesis.
Bats are not blind, as they have excellent eyesight and also use echolocation to navigate and hunt in the dark.
Ostriches do not bury their heads in the sand, but rather lower their heads to the ground to hide from predators.
Goldfish actually have memories that last for months, allowing them to remember feeding times and recognize their human owners.
Humans use virtually all of their brain, with different areas actively processing information throughout the entire day.
Human blood is always red, but it looks dark red in veins under the skin due to how light penetrates.
Touching a frog or toad will not give you warts, because warts are caused by human skin viruses.
Autumn leaves change color because shorter days stop chlorophyll production, revealing the hidden yellow and orange pigments underneath.
Daddy longlegs are actually harvestmen arachnids, not true spiders, and they do not possess any venom at all.
Spiders avoid sleeping humans because our breathing and heartbeats create vibrations that easily scare them away.
Mature sunflowers face east all day, while only young, growing sunflowers actually track the sun across the sky.
Chameleons change color primarily to regulate their body temperature and communicate their mood, rather than to camouflage.
